title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Account Agreement — Small-Balance Allowance on the Late Payment Charge
content:
**Clause.** The late payment charge for a closed statement of a Ridgeline Pro Credit commercial account is computed on the late charge base: the statement's past-due amount less the small-balance allowance, never below zero. The minimum late payment charge applies only when the late charge base is above zero; when the base is zero, no late payment charge is charged.

## The allowance

The small-balance allowance is set by the account's payment record over the last 24 months:

| Payments returned in the last 24 months | Payment lines credited in the last 24 months | Small-balance allowance |
|---|---|---|
| None | At least 12 | 1000.00 (steady-payer allowance) |
| None | Fewer than 12 | 500.00 (standard allowance) |
| One or more | Any | Zero |

The 24 months are whole calendar months counted back from the date the charge is assessed. Payment lines are the payment lines credited to the account; a payment applied to several invoices appears as several payment lines. A returned payment is shown by a returned payment line on the account.

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

| Past-due amount | Record | Allowance | Late charge base |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4200.00 | No returns, 14 payment lines | 1000.00 | 3200.00 |
| 4200.00 | No returns, 9 payment lines | 500.00 | 3700.00 |
| 4200.00 | One return 20 months ago | 0.00 | 4200.00 |
| 760.00 | No returns, 12 payment lines | 1000.00 | 0.00, so nothing is charged |
